# openfluids

> Open tools for fluid flows.

A machine-made house: from the run to the result.

## Analysis

- [openmodalpy](https://github.com/openfluids/openmodalpy): Modal decompositions (POD, DMD, SPOD and more) in one Python workflow
- [dsgbr](https://github.com/openfluids/dsgbr): Peak detection for noisy, sloped power spectra, benchmarked against SciPy
- [fftkit](https://github.com/openfluids/fftkit): One FFT API over many backends, with correctness checks and benchmarks

## Runs and frames

- [hpckit](https://github.com/openfluids/hpckit): HPC work over SSH and Slurm: run packets, receipts, artifact sync
- [quadros](https://github.com/openfluids/quadros): CFD snapshots rendered into checked frames and videos

## Houses

- [machine-made](https://machine-made.github.io/): the umbrella over every house
- [BoringQuantSystems](https://github.com/BoringQuantSystems): deterministic quant engines

An open-source workshop. Built by agents, guided by humans.
